[[File:VB1-L-precisehit-pre.gif|thumb|right|250px|[[Precise Hit (V)]]: the PC card image prints the 2009 text.]]
'''Players Committee transcription errors''' are mistakes in the card text that the [[Players Committee]] (PC) published or kept for its [[Virtual Legacy]] cards (2009&ndash;2014): a document that printed an older text after a newer one had been published, card data that gave a card the text of a different card, release sheets re-made with later errata but still carrying their first date, and smaller slips and typos. Because the PC published the same card in several documents, these errors explain why a card article on this wiki, the card in [[GEMP]] and a given PC document sometimes show different text for the same card. The wider history of how Legacy text was copied between documents, and how this wiki counts versions, is in [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History]].

== The documents involved ==
The PC put Legacy card text in five kinds of document: the release sheets of each [[Virtual Block 1|Virtual Block]] (PDFs marked "Official text as of" a date), errata posts, the card list on the PC website (with game text from 2012 to early 2013), the Virtual Cards Master List ("official text as of April 27, 2013") and the PC card images. Behind them sat card data that the PC did not call official: the [[Holotable]] data files and, later, the PC's JSON card data, from which GEMP and other tools take their text. The table of documents, with dates, is in [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History#The documents|the history article]].

== The Master List prints older text ==
The Master List of 27 April 2013 (the PDF files were built in February 2014)<ref name="ml">Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List, [[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Light Side]] and [[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Dark Side]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Originals: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf and http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copies: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive (Light Side)], [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive (Dark Side)]</ref> prints, for many Legacy cards, the text of the 2009 release sheets, although the PC's own website card list already had a newer text for those cards. The card list showed each card's game text in its links' hover text; the Wayback Machine captured it with text on 21 July 2012, on 11&ndash;13 December 2012 and on 11 January 2013, and from 13 March 2013 the lists give names only.<ref name="cl">Players Committee website card lists, for example [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html VBlock1Type] (Internet Archive, 21 July 2012) and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121213050628/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Name.html VBlock1Name] (Internet Archive, 13 December 2012). From [https://web.archive.org/web/20130313220753/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 13 March 2013] the lists give only names and image links.</ref> A word-by-word search of the Master List in November 2026 found 234 Legacy printings where the Master List prints the older words after the card list had published a different text.<ref name="r8">[https://github.com/billbisco/ai-team-skills/blob/824fa96288aca451da401df7d4cd1aa51c831baa/shared/gemp-legacy-cards/versions/R8-EVERY-PUBLICATION-INVENTORY.md "Every publication is a version" inventory] (research notes R8, 11 November 2026), § Method and § Counts</ref>

[[Precise Hit (V)]] is an example. The [[Virtual Block 1]] sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009) reads "LOST: Cancel Heroic (and any immunity to attrition) on a character or starship this turn."<ref name="vb1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=11 Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 11, slip 160. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=11 Internet Archive]</ref> By 21 July 2012 the card list had "may place target" in the USED half and "LOST: Target a Heroic character or starship. It loses Heroic and/or immunity to attrition, if any, this turn."<ref name="cl" /> The PC card image and the Master List print the 2009 words again.<ref name="ml" />

For a time this wiki treated such Master List copies as a stale reprint of the older version, with the 2012 card-list text as the latest. Since 11 November 2026 every published text counts as a version: the Master List copy is a version of its own, dated 27 April 2013, and as the latest publication it is the current text.<ref name="rulings">[https://github.com/billbisco/ai-team-skills/blob/824fa96288aca451da401df7d4cd1aa51c831baa/shared/gemp-legacy-cards/RULINGS.md Card version rulings] (8&ndash;11 November 2026), entries of 8 November (option b) and 11 November 07:42 ("every publication is a version")</ref> The versions of Precise Hit (V) are [[Precise Hit (V)]] (sheet), [[Precise Hit (V) (Errata)]] (card list), [[Precise Hit (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC card image) and [[Precise Hit (V) (Errata 3)]] (Master List, current).

== Card data with another card's text ==
The PC's JSON card data for Legacy cards gives several cards the text of a different card. The 2012 card list, the release sheets, the Master List and the card images all have the real text.<ref name="slipaudit">[https://github.com/billbisco/ai-team-skills/blob/824fa96288aca451da401df7d4cd1aa51c831baa/shared/gemp-legacy-cards/SLIP-TEXT-AUDIT-2026-11-07.md Legacy slip-text audit] (research notes, 7 November 2026), § A</ref><ref name="es">[https://github.com/billbisco/ai-team-skills/blob/824fa96288aca451da401df7d4cd1aa51c831baa/shared/gemp-legacy-cards/versions/errata-sources.md Dated sources for Virtual Legacy errata] (research notes, 8 November 2026), § Bottom line, item 2</ref> The 2010 Holotable data has the right text for all of these cards,<ref name="cdf">Holotable card data, version 20100529: [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/darkside.cdf darkside.cdf] and [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/lightside.cdf lightside.cdf] (committed 13 July 2010)</ref> so the wrong texts entered the data later. They were already there when the PC moved its Legacy cards into their own files on 11 March 2021.<ref name="json2021">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/f42eed0ffa9722adfbb469d7707d31947c9cfd54/DarkLegacy.json DarkLegacy.json] and [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/f42eed0ffa9722adfbb469d7707d31947c9cfd54/LightLegacy.json LightLegacy.json] at commit f42eed0 ("Pulled legacy cards out into their own Light/Dark-legacy.json files", 11 March 2021)</ref> In the copies examined in November 2026 they were still there.<ref name="json2026">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/65cd150d20634447a5499d763ac324436158c7a8/DarkLegacy.json DarkLegacy.json] and [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/65cd150d20634447a5499d763ac324436158c7a8/LightLegacy.json LightLegacy.json] at commit 65cd150 (21 October 2026)</ref>

GEMP took its Legacy text from the PC data, so its versions of these cards played the wrong card until they were corrected in 2026.<ref name="slipaudit" /> Two similar faults in GEMP did not come from the PC data, which has the right text for both: [[Hound's Tooth (V) (Virtual Block 2)|Hound's Tooth (V)]] played the text of the Decipher card [[Hound's Tooth]] ("May add 1 pilot (must be smuggler or bounty hunter)..."), and [[Chokk (V)]] had no game text at all. Both have since been corrected.<ref name="slipaudit" /><ref name="json2026" />

== Text found only in card data ==
Two texts in the PC data were at first found in no dated PC document:
* '''The "swing" clause.''' On [[He's No Jedi]] and [[Jabba, This Is Your Last Chance!]] the data has lightsabers that "may not add to Force drains or 'swing' more than once per battle"; the 2009 sheet, the Master List and the card images say only that they "may not add to Force drains".<ref name="slipaudit" /> The clause was later found in the Holotable data of 29 May 2010<ref name="cdf" /> and on the PC website card list of 21 July 2012, so it is a text the PC published, not a later copying error.<ref name="cl" /><ref name="es" /> It is the version [[He's No Jedi (Errata)]] and [[Jabba, This Is Your Last Chance! (Errata)]].
* '''The Fleet Security Protocols rewrite.''' The data gives [[Fleet Security Protocols]] a different text ("characters at related starship (or vehicle) sites cumulatively add 2 to your total power..."), where the sheet makes the starship itself "power +2 for each of your characters at its related sites".<ref name="slipaudit" /> This text too was in the 2010 Holotable data and on the 2012 card list,<ref name="cdf" /><ref name="cl" /> and is the version [[Fleet Security Protocols (Errata 2)]].
The history article traces both texts to temporary Holotable files built from the PC's text spoilers in August 2009, before the release sheet came out (see [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History#Fleet Security Protocols and He's No Jedi|Fleet Security Protocols and He's No Jedi]]).

== Re-made sheets that keep their first date ==
Three release sheets on the PC's file server are later copies, re-made after errata, although their header still gives the date of the first printing. The dates of the re-makes come from the PDF files' own creation dates.<ref name="es" />

A sheet of this kind is therefore not a copy of the first printing. For the cards above, the text the sheet shows is an errata version, and the first printing has to be found elsewhere: in a PC news post that quotes the change, in the card list, in a card image, or not at all. No copy of the first Virtual Block 7.3 printing has been found, so the first text of Master Kenobi is reconstructed from the errata post, and the first Virtual Block 8.1 printing of Scoundrel's Luck is lost.<ref name="es" /> By contrast the Virtual Block 7.4 sheet on the server is byte for byte the copy the PC offered for download in February 2012, so it is the first printing.<ref name="es" />

On these cards the image and sheet text is treated as the original version and the Master List text as a later errata, which is the current text.<ref name="rulings" /> An image is therefore not proof of a card's current text, and neither is a Master List entry on its own (see [[#The Master List prints older text|above]]). == Errata marks that do not match the version (Virtual Modern) ==
Modern Virtual card images print an errata mark ("E1", "E2"…) at bottom right. On some re-made images the PC did not update the mark, so the printed mark does not match the card's version. The wiki numbers the versions by release order and records the printed mark (Bill, 12 November 2026).<ref name="ht-sla">Players Committee card images in the PC's Holotable image repository: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a324c4e1f244362a7211644a9d5ec6f816d78ccb/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/scomplinkaccess.gif Scomp Link Access (V), July 2024] and [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b3853e63328481978b065262318c0dc4e88b44b6/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/scomplinkaccess.gif March 2026]; [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/937f50b401597ac4bd6031307ab412324907e814/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/passagetothealderaansystem.gif Passage To The Alderaan System, 25 July 2024] and [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/passagetothealderaansystem.gif 30 December 2024].</ref> The PC prints an errata mark (“E”, “E1”, “E2”…) in the bottom right corner of some changed [[Virtual Modern]] cards; the marks do not always follow the order in which the PC published the card's versions: some cards print the same mark on two different texts, some restart the count after a remaster, some changed cards print no mark, and alternate-image (AI/ALT) cards print the mark of the base card's errata.<ref name="vmmarks">Players Committee card images in the PC's Holotable image set ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable swccgpc/holotable], <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1x-*</code>), each version dated by the commit that published it; see the source links on each card article.</ref>

== Smaller slips ==
* '''Typos printed on Alternate Image cards (Virtual Modern, Sets 0–3).''' The PC printed these on its ALT card images and fixed them on a later image; each image is its own version and the wiki shows the words as printed: [[Conquest (V) (ALT)]] lore “Millemium Falcon” (fixed to “Millennium” on [[Conquest (V) (ALT) (Errata)]], 19 February 2023); [[Count Dooku (ALT)]] lore “Serennoian leader” (fixed to “Serennian” on [[Count Dooku (ALT) (Errata)]], 10 August 2022); [[Azure Angel (ALT)]] and [[Azure Angel (ALT) (Errata)]] concept credit “Original concept by Keivn Shannon” (fixed to “Kevin” on [[Azure Angel (ALT) (Errata 2)]], 15 January 2022).
* '''A lost clause.''' The front of [[Infiltration / Unlikely Allies]] reads, on the Virtual Block 8.1 sheet and in the Master List, "While this side up, your Force drains at systems are -1. May use 1 Force to ▲ Imperial Navigation Charts. Flip this card if Imperial Navigation Charts is 'stolen.'"<ref name="vb81" /><ref name="ml" /> The PC card data leaves out the middle sentence and doubles a word: "Flip this card if If Imperial Navigation Charts is 'stolen'". GEMP's card, built from the data, lacked the clause too until it was corrected.<ref name="json2026" /><ref name="slipaudit" />
* '''One side copied onto the other.''' [[Rebel Cell - Situation Room]] gives both sides the power bonus on the sheet ("For each of your characters here, your power is +1 at related system").<ref name="vb4" /> In the PC card data the Dark Side text is instead a copy of the Light Side's first sentence, "Deploys only to same planet system as Rebel Cell - Hidden Landing Site." GEMP's card had the same fault until it was corrected.<ref name="json2026" /><ref name="slipaudit" />
* '''The wrong back side in GEMP.''' The back of GEMP's [[Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]] had the text of the [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II]] objective the slip is placed over, [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]] (smugglers and Kessel Runs), instead of the Virtual Block 4 text ("non-blaster character weapon destiny draws are -2 at Corellia sites..."). The PC data has the right text, so this error was GEMP's own; it has since been corrected.<ref name="vb4" /><ref name="json2026" />
* '''Typos.''' The 2012&ndash;2013 card list has typos found in no other PC document, among them "whever" ([[A Disturbance In The Force (V)]]), "damagethis" ([[Collateral Damage (V)]]), "retireved" ([[Away Put Your Weapon (V) (Errata 3)|Away Put Your Weapon (V)]]), "dpeloys" ([[So Be It, Jedi]]), "traget" ([[Evacuate? (V)]]) and "Epic Even" ([[Luke, Trust Me (Errata 2)|Luke, Trust Me]]).<ref name="cl" /><ref name="audit1108">[https://github.com/billbisco/ai-team-skills/blob/824fa96288aca451da401df7d4cd1aa51c831baa/shared/gemp-legacy-cards/versions/AUDIT-2026-11-08.md Legacy version audit] (research notes, 8 November 2026), § C</ref> The sheets have their own: the Virtual Block 8.1 sheet's Infiltration says "For reminder of game".<ref name="vb81" /> Card articles on this wiki show each text exactly as published, typos included, and every published text is a version of its card.<ref name="rulings" />

== Commence Recharging image mark ==
The second PC image, [[Commence Recharging (PC Errata 2)]], prints D-E1. The third and fourth PC images, [[Commence Recharging (PC Errata 3)]] and [[Commence Recharging (PC Errata 4)]], both print D-E2. Their numeric printed marks differ from their PC image-version ordinals.<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-commencerecharging-holotable-2022-12-23.png|Second PC image]]; [[:File:ANH-L-commencerecharging-holotable-2023-02-19.png|Third PC image]]; [[:File:ANH-L-commencerecharging-holotable-2023-07-03.png|Fourth PC image]].</ref>

[[Commence Recharging (PC Errata 3)|The 19 February 2023 PC image]] says “If just fired at a planet, Effect is canceled.” [[Commence Recharging (PC Errata 4)|The 3 July 2023 PC image]] changes “planet” to “system”, but both images print D-E2. The printed mark did not change with that wording. <ref>[[:File:ANH-L-commencerecharging-holotable-2023-02-19.png|19 February 2023 image]]; [[:File:ANH-L-commencerecharging-holotable-2023-07-03.png|3 July 2023 image]].</ref>
